definitions.explanation: A piece of armor carried to protect the body in combat. In modern Japanese, commonly used figuratively to mean something that protects or serves as a defense.
Something used as a protective cover for one's true intentions or actions. Often appears in the phrase 〜を{盾|たて}にする (to use ~ as a shield/excuse).

examples.japanese: {盾|たて}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To protect one's body with a shield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: He used his illness as an excuse to take time off work.
examples.notes: 〜を盾にする = to use ~ as an excuse/shield

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卑怯|ひきょう}→卑怯：04345_hikyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's cowardly to escape using a child as a shield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盾|たて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}えて→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The police held up shields and faced the demonstrators.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盾|たて}⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{弾|たま}→弾：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{防|ふせ}げない→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: A wooden shield can't stop bullets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払：03193_shiharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{誘|さそ}い→誘い：14200_sasoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}った→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。

The knight blocked the arrows with his shield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しさ→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was absent from the meeting, using being busy as an excuse.

notes:
USAGE: In modern Japanese, the figurative meaning (excuse, pretext) is more common than the literal meaning (physical shield). Japanese samurai historically did not use shields as commonly as Western soldiers since they needed both hands for swords and bows.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to use as a shield/excuse)
- {盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as protection)
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盾|たて} (shield of the law)
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盾|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hide behind human rights)

RELATED: ⟦{矛|ほこ}→矛：28779_hoko⟧ (spear) - these two words appear together in the famous Chinese story about contradiction (⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧).
